## How to run it

[context specification source](https://huggingface.co/LiquidAI/LFM2.5-1.2B-Thinking/blob/f313478934a7612d22991f752959d7a1a8756fec/README.md) · Liquid AI official model card: LFM2.5-1.2B-Thinking context length 32,768 tokens. Observed 2026-09-25.

ollama run lfm2.5-thinking:1.2b-q8_0
